Hammer Hall

Where the under-winds of Mount Dun first meet the mountain's maw stands Hammer Hall, sanctum of the Hammers of Restoration. Wreathed in prophecy older than the stone itself, they swore to guard the gates of Duunhold beyond the span of mortal life. Their sacred code became the forge-fire from which the steadfast ranks of guardians have been tempered for untold generations.
